groups.label: Identify polynomial functions and state their degree

statements.text: The function f: R → R where f(x) = a_0 + a_1 x + a_2 x^2 + ... + a_n x^n, where a_0, a_1, a_2, ... a_n ∈ R, n ∈ N, a_n ≠ 0, is called a polynomial of degree n. Formula: $f(x)=a_0+a_1x+a_2x^2+\dots+a_nx^n, \ a_0, a_1, \dots, a_n\in\mathbb{R}, \ n\in\mathbb{N}, \ a_n\neq 0$
The degree of the polynomial is the highest power of the variable in the function rule.

groups.label: Represent linear and constant functions graphically

statements.text: The function f: R → R where f(x) = ax + b, a, b ∈ R, a ≠ 0, is called a linear function or a function of the first degree. Formula: $f(x)=ax+b, \ a, b\in\mathbb{R}, \ a\neq 0$
It is enough to find two ordered pairs belonging to the function; it is preferred to find a third ordered pair to check the graph.
If f: R → R, f(x) = ax, where a ≠ 0, then it is represented graphically by a straight line passing through the origin (0, 0). Formula: $f(x)=ax, \ a\neq 0$

If f: R → R, f(x) = b where b ∈ R, then f is called a constant function. For example f(x) = 3, written as y = 3. It is represented by a straight line parallel to the x-axis. Formula: $f(x)=b, \ b\in R$
The function f: R → R where f(x) = ax² + bx + c, with a, b, c real numbers and a ≠ 0, is called a quadratic function and it is a function of second degree. Formula: $f(x)=ax^2+bx+c, \ a\neq 0$

groups.label: Find the vertex, axis of symmetry and extreme value of a quadratic

statements.text: The curve of the function f is symmetrical about the y-axis and the equation of the symmetrical axis is x = 0.
The coordinate of the vertex of the curve is (0, 0), and the minimum value of the function = 0.
The coordinates of the vertex of the curve are (-b/2a, f(-b/2a)). Formula: $\left(\frac{-b}{2a}, f\left(\frac{-b}{2a}\right)\right)$
The curve is open upwards when the coefficient of x² is positive (a > 0), and in this case the function has a minimum value equal to f(-b/2a). Formula: $f\left(\frac{-b}{2a}\right)$
The curve is open downward when the coefficient of x² is negative (a < 0), and in this case the function has a maximum value equal to f(-b/2a). Formula: $f\left(\frac{-b}{2a}\right)$
The curve is symmetric about the vertical line through the vertex of the curve, whose equation is X = -b/2a; this line is called the axis of symmetry of the function. Formula: $x=\frac{-b}{2a}$
